formulas.formula: sigma* is MSNE iff E[u_i(sigma*_i, sigma*_{-i})] >= E[u_i(s'_i, sigma*_{-i})] for all mixed s'_i
formulas.description: 玩家以概率分布随机选择策略的纳什均衡

formulas.name: AGM信念修正六公设
formulas.formula: (K*1) K*phi is a belief set. (K*2) phi in K*phi. (K*3) K*phi subset K+phi. (K*4) if not-phi not in K then K+phi subset K*phi. (K*5) K*phi = K_perp iff phi is contradictory. (K*6) if phi<=>psi then K*phi = K*psi
formulas.description: Alchourron-Gardenfors-Makinson信念修正理论的六条基本公设

formulas.name: 奥卡姆剃刀（概率形式）
formulas.formula: P(H_i|E) approx P(E|H_i) * P(H_i), simpler H_i with fewer params has higher prior P(H_i)
formulas.description: 简单假设有更高的先验概率，贝叶斯奥卡姆剃刀

formulas.name: 不确定性论题（Duhem-Quine）
formulas.formula: evidence underdetermines theory: for any E, exists H1, H2 such that P(E|H1)=P(E|H2) but H1 != H2
formulas.description: 同一证据可由多个不相容理论同等解释

formulas.name: 融贯论证成
formulas.formula: J(belief) = sum_{i != j} (consistency(b_i, b_j) + explanatory_coherence(b_i, b_j)) / n
formulas.description: 信念的证成程度取决于它在信念网络中的融贯性

formulas.name: 可靠主义证成（Goldman）
formulas.formula: belief B is justified iff B is produced by a reliable process R where P(R produces true belief) > threshold
formulas.description: 信念的证成取决于产生它的认知过程的可靠性

formulas.name: 索萨德性认识论（AAA模型）
formulas.description: 知识是真确的(accurate)、灵巧的(adroit)和适当的(apt)信念

formulas.name: 功利主义社会福利函数
formulas.formula: SWF = sum_i u_i(x) (Bentham) or SWF = min_i u_i(x) (Rawlsian)
formulas.description: 边沁:总效用最大化, 罗尔斯:最少受惠者效用最大化

formulas.name: 诺齐克持有正义三原则
formulas.description: 获取正义+转让正义+矫正正义：符合三者之一的持有就是正义的

formulas.name: 机会均等形式原则
formulas.formula: fair_competition: P(success_i) = f(effort_i, talent_i) NOT f(circumstance_i)
formulas.description: 成功应仅取决于努力和才能而非出身等境况

formulas.name: 自由主义最小国家（Nozick）
formulas.formula: state_scope = { only protection_against_force, theft, fraud, enforcement_of_contracts }
formulas.description: 国家仅限保护性功能，任何再分配都是侵犯权利

formulas.name: 可行能力方法（Sen/Nussbaum）
formulas.description: 福利不是拥有什么而是能做什么和成为什么

formulas.name: 商议民主模型
formulas.description: 合法政治决策来自自由平等的公民之间的理性商议

formulas.name: 洛必达法则
formulas.formula: lim_{x->a} f(x)/g(x) = lim_{x->a} f'(x)/g'(x), if form 0/0 or inf/inf

formulas.name: 奇异值分解(SVD)
formulas.formula: A = U*Sigma*V^T, U^T*U = I, V^T*V = I, Sigma = diag(sigma_1,...,sigma_r)

formulas.name: 格拉姆-施密特正交化
formulas.formula: u_k = v_k - sum_{j=1}^{k-1} proj_{u_j}(v_k), e_k = u_k/||u_k||

formulas.name: Cholesky分解
formulas.formula: A = L*L^T, where L is lower triangular and A is SPD

formulas.name: Fano不等式
formulas.formula: H(X|Y) <= H_2(P_e) + P_e*log(|X|-1), P_e = P(X != X_hat)

formulas.name: 数据处理不等式
formulas.formula: I(X;Z) <= I(X;Y) for Markov chain X->Y->Z

formulas.name: 微分熵
formulas.formula: h(X) = -integral f(x)*log(f(x))dx for continuous random variable X

formulas.name: 拉格朗日乘数法
formulas.formula: L(x,lambda) = f(x) + sum_i lambda_i*g_i(x), grad_L = 0 at optimum

formulas.name: KKT条件
formulas.formula: grad_f(x*) + sum_i mu_i*grad_h_i(x*) + sum_j lambda_j*grad_g_j(x*) = 0, lambda_j*g_j(x*) = 0, lambda_j >= 0

formulas.name: Adam优化器
formulas.formula: m_t = beta1*m_{t-1} + (1-beta1)*g_t, v_t = beta2*v_{t-1} + (1-beta2)*g_t^2, theta_t = theta_{t-1} - eta*m_t_hat/(sqrt(v_t_hat)+eps)

formulas.name: 图拉普拉斯矩阵
formulas.formula: L = D - A, D_ii = deg(v_i), A_ij = 1 if edge ij exists

formulas.name: 特征向量中心性
formulas.formula: c_v = (1/lambda)*sum_{u in N(v)} c_u, where A*c = lambda*c

formulas.name: 注意资源分配
formulas.formula: R_allocation = sum_i w_i*S_i, with sum_i w_i <= total_capacity

formulas.name: 知觉负载理论
formulas.formula: Distraction = f(perceptual_load, distractor_salience), negative if load > threshold

formulas.name: 全局神经工作空间(GNW)
formulas.formula: P_conscious = sigmoid(I_stimulus - theta_gnw), ignition when global_avalanche > threshold

formulas.name: 动态核理论
formulas.formula: D_core = functional_cluster with high mutual_info_integration and low mutual_info_segregation

formulas.name: 默认模式网络(DMN)
formulas.formula: DMN_activity = f(task_difficulty, self_referential_thought), DMN anticorrelated with task_positive_network

formulas.name: ACT-R产生式规则
formulas.formula: If goal_type = G and condition C then action A, Utility = P_success*G_cost - P_failure*F_cost

formulas.name: ACT-R认知架构缓冲区
formulas.formula: Buffer_state = f(retrieval_goal, imaginal, manual, vocal, visual), each buffer holds one chunk

formulas.name: Soar决策周期
formulas.formula: Decision = propose(operators) -> compare(preferences) -> select(best) -> apply(operator), timeout -> impasse -> subgoal

formulas.name: 心理模型理论
formulas.formula: Validity = models_where_conclusion_holds / total_models, fewer models -> faster reasoning

formulas.name: 类比推理与迁移
formulas.formula: P(transfer) = f(structural_similarity, surface_similarity), structural_similarity > surface_similarity for deep transfer

formulas.name: 顿悟问题解决
formulas.formula: P(solution) = f(incubation_time, restructuring), insight marked by sudden spike in solution_probability

formulas.name: 校准曲线
formulas.formula: Calibration = mean((confidence_i - accuracy_i)^2, i in bins), perfect = 0

formulas.name: 自知力偏差
formulas.formula: Insight_bias = mean_confidence - mean_accuracy, positive = overconfidence, negative = underconfidence

formulas.name: Dunning-Kruger效应
formulas.formula: Self_assessed_ability = true_ability + bias, bias = f(true_ability), high at low ability, low at high ability

formulas.name: 知晓感(FOK)
formulas.formula: FOK_accuracy = P(recognize|FOK_yes) - P(recognize|FOK_no), gamma correlation for tip_of_tongue states

formulas.name: 学习判断(JOL)
formulas.formula: JOL_accuracy = P(recall|JOL) - baseline_recall, delayed_JOL more accurate than immediate_JOL
